attribution: Circle of the Symbiote — Cthulhu by Torchlight (CBT). Short mechanical summaries.

features.name: Circle of the Symbiote
features.description: A circle of druids bonded with a plant symbiote that grows across their bodies.

features.name: Circle of the Symbiote Spells
features.description: The circle grants always-prepared spells at druid levels 3, 5, 7 and 9.

features.name: Primal Symbiote
features.description: Fortifying Presence: Advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration.

features.name: Symbiotic Transformation
features.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a use of Wild Shape to gain +2 AC, Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

features.name: Symbiotic Reflexes
features.description: Haste is always prepared. While transformed, you can cast Haste on yourself without a spell slot or components (limited uses).
